tasks.title: Fix Chzzk comment collection - zero comments stored despite successful video sync
tasks.description:
CRITICAL BUG: Channel sync successfully stores video metadata but all videos show totalComments=0 and timelineComments=0 in database. Root cause analysis reveals three specific issues in src/app/api/chzzk-sync/route.ts:

## Issue 1: Silent Error Handling (Lines 250-256)
`fetchChzzkComments()` catches ALL errors and returns empty array without propagating failure:
```javascript
catch (error) {
  console.error(`Error fetching comments for video ${videoNo}:`, error);
  hasMore = false;  // Just stops loop
}
return allComments;  // Returns [] on error
```

Problem: If comment API fails (wrong endpoint, auth, rate limit), sync completes 'successfully' with 0 comments.

Fix Required:
- Add detailed error logging with response status/body (like video API at lines 170-175)
- Log response structure to verify `data.comments` path (line 239)
- Consider throwing error instead of silent fail, OR track error count in return value
- Test actual comment API response structure

## Issue 2: Existing Videos Skip Comment Collection (Lines 373-383, 789-794)
Both SSE stream and POST handlers skip existing videos:
```javascript
const existingVideo = await ChzzkVideo.findOne({ videoNo: videoData.videoNo });
if (existingVideo && !force) {
  continue;  // SKIPS comment fetch entirely!
}
```

Scenario:
1. First sync: Videos saved, but comment API fails silently → totalComments=0
2. Second sync: existingVideo=true, force=false → continue → comments NEVER collected
3. User has videos with 0 comments forever unless they use force=true

Fix Options:
A. Always fetch comments even for existing videos (update lastCommentSync)
B. Check if totalComments=0 and re-fetch comments
C. Force user to use force=true flag for comment re-collection
D. Add separate 'sync comments only' action

## Issue 3: Unverified Comment API Response Structure (Line 239)
Code assumes: `data.comments` contains array
Possible issues:
- API might return different structure (e.g., `data.content.data`)
- API might require different parameters
- API endpoint might be outdated/changed

Fix Required:
- Manually test comment API with curl to verify response structure
- Log full response body when comments.length=0 to see actual structure
- Compare with actual Chzzk website's comment fetch network request

## Debug Steps:

1. Add comprehensive logging to fetchChzzkComments:
   ```javascript
   console.log(`[fetchChzzkComments] Fetching for video ${videoNo}`);
   console.log(`[fetchChzzkComments] Response status:`, response.status);
   const data = await response.json();
   console.log(`[fetchChzzkComments] Response keys:`, Object.keys(data));
   console.log(`[fetchChzzkComments] Comments count:`, data.comments?.length || 0);
   ```

2. Test comment API manually:
   ```bash
   curl 'https://apis.naver.com/nng_main/nng_comment_api/v1/type/STREAMING_VIDEO/id/11162022/comments?limit=30&offset=0&orderType=POPULAR&pagingType=PAGE' \
   -H 'front-client-platform-type: PC' \
     -H 'front-client-product-type: web'
   ```

3. Check database state:
   - Count videos: `db.chzzkvideos.count()`
   - Count comments: `db.chzzkcomments.count()`
   - Find videos with 0 comments: `db.chzzkvideos.find({totalComments: 0})`

4. Fix skip logic (choose option A, B, C, or D above)

5. Re-run sync and verify comments are collected

Reference Files:
- Main logic: src/app/api/chzzk-sync/route.ts
- SSE stream: lines 358-460
- POST handler: lines 770-850
- Comment fetch: lines 208-257
acceptanceCriteria: fetchChzzkComments logs detailed info on every call (video number, response status, comment count)
Comment API errors are properly logged with response body (not silently ignored)
Actual comment API response structure is verified and logged
Manual curl test of comment API succeeds and returns data
Comment collection logic handles existing videos correctly (doesn't skip forever)
After sync, ChzzkComment collection contains actual comments (count > 0)
ChzzkVideo records show accurate totalComments and timelineComments (not all 0)

completed.title: Add regex injection protection for search query
completed.description:
HIGH SECURITY RISK: Search query directly uses user input in MongoDB $regex without escaping, enabling:
- Regex Denial of Service (ReDoS) attacks with patterns like (a+)+$
- Unintended results with special regex characters
- Potential NoSQL injection attempts

Implement input sanitization:

1. Create escapeRegex() utility function to escape special characters: .*+?^${}()|[]\n2. Apply escaping to search parameter before using in MongoDB query
3. Test with malicious patterns to verify protection
4. Alternative: Consider using MongoDB text search index instead

Reference: BUGS_FOUND.md BUG-011 (lines 262-321)
acceptanceCriteria: Search input escapes all regex special characters
Search query treats input as literal string
ReDoS patterns like (a+)+$ don't cause performance issues
Normal searches still work correctly

completed.title: Implement retry logic with exponential backoff
completed.description:
HIGH RELIABILITY: Network failures during channel sync cause permanent data loss with no retry mechanism. Affects:
- Transient network errors
- API rate limiting (429 status)
- Server errors (5xx status)
- Timeout issues

Implement robust retry system:

1. Create fetchWithRetry() utility function
2. Implement exponential backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s delays
3. Retry on: network errors, 429 status, 500-599 status
4. Don't retry on: 400-499 status (except 429), successful responses
5. Apply to all Chzzk API calls in sync operation
6. Track and report retry counts in sync results

Reference: BUGS_FOUND.md BUG-003 (lines 185-257) and BUG-012 (lines 472-502)
acceptanceCriteria: fetchWithRetry() function implemented with exponential backoff
Network errors trigger automatic retry (max 3 attempts)
429 rate limit status triggers retry with backoff
5xx server errors trigger retry
4xx errors (except 429) fail immediately without retry
Retry delays increase exponentially: 1s, 2s, 4s

Failed videos logged separately after all retries exhausted
